header.title: Kabumemo
header.tagline: A local investment ledger powered by broker reports.

overview.title: A trading dashboard that feels closer to a neobank than a spreadsheet.
overview.description: Use the top cards to scan your live trades, positions, FX activity, and tax pressure before diving into details.
overview.chartCaption: A simplified visualization based on the current aggregated fund totals.
overview.chartEmpty: Import or record trades to populate the overview chart.

goal.title: USD 100k Goal
goal.captionLive: JPY and USD assets are converted once using the live USD/JPY rate fetched when the page opens.
goal.captionFallback: Live FX was unavailable, so the goal currently uses only the USD fund total.

transactions.title: Trades
transactions.description: Record buy and sell transactions with optional notes and tax status.
transactions.editingHint: Editing existing trade. Save to apply changes or cancel to go back to quick entry.

manual.hint: Use only to correct missing or exceptional broker-report trades

validation.settlementCurrencyMismatch: Settlement currency must match the selected settlement group's currency.

roundYield.selectionHint: Pick buys and sells across pages to evaluate a full round trip.

validation.fundingGroup: Select trades from the same funding group.
validation.market: Select trades from the same market.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Calculate remaining holdings, average cost, and realized P&L from trades.

summary.marketValueHint: JPY and USD are kept separate

splitDetection.title: Split candidates
splitDetection.description: Uses explicit corporate actions, never price movement guesses. You can edit the suggested quantity before applying.
splitDetection.summary: Scanned {count} symbols and found {candidates} unrecorded events.
splitDetection.failed: Corporate actions could not be loaded for: {symbols}
splitDetection.empty: No unrecorded stock splits were found.
splitDetection.invalidQuantity: Corrected quantity must be greater than zero.

positions.selectionHint: Select a row for funding-group details and price history

funds.title: Funds & Groups
funds.description: Review JPY and USD accounts and cash activity reconstructed from broker reports.

cashLedger.description: {count} broker-report entries. JPY and USD stay separate while linked transfers reconcile automatically.
cashLedger.empty: Import a cash report to begin

exchangeRate.label: USD → JPY rate
exchangeRate.helper: The page fetches USD/JPY once on load and uses it for the merged fund overview.
exchangeRate.invalid: Please enter a positive exchange rate.
exchangeRate.required: Live FX is unavailable, so USD balances cannot be converted right now.

capitalDialog.title: Add capital to {name}
capitalDialog.description: Pick the date the new funds become active. Future-dated capital won't dilute current-year returns.

capitalHistory.title: Capital additions
capitalHistory.description: Track every capital injection sorted by effective date.

fx.title: FX Exchanges
fx.description: Log manual JPY/USD conversions and link them to trades when needed.
fx.missingHint: These trades still need a linked FX record:

stockSplits.title: Stock Splits
stockSplits.description: Record corporate stock split events so positions, average cost, and realized P&L are recalculated correctly.

confirm.mustKeepOne: Keep at least one funding group.

tax.title: Tax Settlement
tax.description: List untaxed sell trades; recording tax updates funding groups and tax status.
tax.descriptionAnnual: Record tax net amounts yearly. Non-NISA sells stay pending until annual settlement.
tax.annualHint: This records yearly net tax results only. It is no longer linked to individual sell transactions.
tax.hint: Choose a sell trade from the left first.
tax.editingHint: Editing the tax record logged on {date}. Saving will refresh funds and trades immediately.
tax.balanceHint: Estimated USD to sell at this rate: {value}
tax.pendingSummary: There are currently {count} non-NISA sell trades pending annual tax settlement.

errors.load: Unable to load annual tax records.
errors.save: Unable to save annual tax record.
errors.delete: Unable to delete annual tax record.

imports.title: Broker Report Import
imports.description: Import broker-exported trade, JPY cash, and foreign-currency reports with linking and duplicate protection.
imports.mappingHint: Keep the defaults unless you use multiple funding groups.
imports.runtimeTarget: This import writes directly into the live data directory used by the running app, not the realdata backup folder.
imports.applyHint: Applying the import appends new trades quickly and skips duplicates that already exist.
imports.previewHint: Preview rows are generated from the uploaded reports and current funding-group mapping.
imports.cashPreviewDescription: Same-day, same-amount JPY and foreign transfer rows are linked to prevent double counting.
imports.cashLedgerDescription: Shows the latest 100 broker rows. Taxes now live in this ledger instead of a separate workflow.
imports.cashEmpty: Select a JPY or foreign cash report to preview it here.
imports.previewSummary: Generated {count} preview rows. {applied} would be imported and {skipped} would be skipped as duplicates.
imports.applyDone: Imported {count} report rows and skipped {skipped} duplicates.

undo.title: Undo latest import
undo.description: Delete the {count} trades that were just imported if this batch was a mistake.
undo.confirm: Delete the {count} trades added by the latest import?

errors.undo: Unable to undo the latest import.

duplicates.title: Suspicious duplicate review
duplicates.description: Scan existing trades for exact-match duplicate groups before deleting anything in bulk.
duplicates.idle: Run a scan to review suspicious duplicates.
duplicates.reason: These rows match on the main trade fields and look like repeated imports.
duplicates.summary: Found {groups} duplicate groups covering {transactions} records. {suggested} records are preselected for deletion.
duplicates.confirmDelete: Delete the selected {count} suspicious duplicate trades?

errors.delete: Unable to delete the selected duplicates.
